name: Tartaros University
card_quote: "I'm competitive but not at the highest level. I want to challenge myself and learn the game."
card_desc: → University was made just for people like you. A structured learning environment still pushing for top 100. Pick up strats from experienced players and genuinely get better at CT.
modal_quote: "I'm competitive but not at the highest level. I want to challenge myself and learn the game."
modal_desc: University sits alongside Academy as a development team, with a stronger focus on learning the fundamentals of CT. If Academy is where you compete while improving, University is where you really dig into the game — understanding the meta, picking up strategies, and building the skills to move up. Experienced players are always on hand to explain, guide, and share knowledge freely.
requirements: Eagerness to learn — that's the whole point of University
Some CT participation — use your attacks and engage with the event
Open to coaching — take on board strats and advice from experienced players
Respectful attitude — we're all at different stages, patience goes both ways
Discord presence — most of the learning and coordination happens here
